Our philosophy is simple: learn first, book second. We want you to really experience a destination before you book it.

That philosophy shaped our App. Before you commit to anything, you see the things that decide whether a day is good or wasted. How crowded a place will be when you arrive. How long the drive really takes. How long you'll queue. Where to eat nearby. The kind of detail you'd usually only discover once you were standing there.

Then the itinerary itself is in video form. You see the experiences, the hotels, the drive, the sunset spot, instead of reading a PDF. And you can make changes instantly: swap a day, slow the pace, add a beach—no days of back and forth with a travel agent.

d:
Hiring shouldn't come down to instinct. Zepcruit makes sure it doesn't.

Gartner research found that more than three in four hiring managers don't make decisive hiring calls and the ones who do, hire 10% more high-quality candidates and 11% fewer low-quality ones. The gap isn't about the effort of the hiring manager; but about what is in front of them when they have to choose between a CV, a conversation and an instinct call at the end of it.

Zepcruit replaces the instinct call with a signal.

Candidates go through AI-conducted structured interviews with proctoring, then get scored against a psychometric-based role fit model. The output is a Predictive Index :- the three numbers built for hiring managers to act on:
— Good to Hire Score: should this candidate be on your shortlist?
— Role Fit Score: how well do their behavioural patterns match the role?
— Performance Predictability Score: how are they likely to perform once they join your organisation.

Tools used today, tells you "who a candidate is on interview day". Where as Zepcruit's Performance Predictability Score tells you what comes after. That's the part of hiring that actually decides whether the hire works.

Built on patent-pending methodology. Designed to inform the hiring decision — not make it.

name: DRISKO.ai
d:
DRISKO.ai helps D2C brands make better decisions across the entire cash-on-delivery order journey—from checkout to delivery, settlement and returns.

Our AI decision layer connects five stages that are often managed separately:

• Checkout intelligence assesses buyer intent and order risk before COD is offered.
• Buyer verification checks orders, addresses and customer signals before dispatch.
• Delivery rescue identifies at-risk shipments and helps resolve issues before they become returns to origin.
• Early COD settlement uses risk intelligence to support faster access to cash through eligible NBFC partners.
• Return intelligence flags potential abuse before a refund decision is made.

DRISKO also re-scores orders between checkout and dispatch, when new risk signals can change the right decision. AI agents can contact buyers across WhatsApp, email, SMS and IVR to confirm orders and resolve delivery gaps.

The platform works alongside a brand’s existing storefront, checkout, couriers and payment providers. Brands keep their vendors and control over their policies. DRISKO starts in shadow mode, then moves to recommendations and automation as the brand gains confidence in its decisions.

We stand behind eligible orders rated Safe: if one still results in an RTO or return, our guarantee covers forward and reverse freight, subject to its terms.

DRISKO.ai is a neutral intelligence layer for COD commerce—not a courier or a lender. We help brands decide when to ship, verify, intervene or hold, so fewer costly mistakes are made across the order lifecycle.

Our guarantee backs eligible COD orders rated Safe: if they still result in an RTO or return, DRISKO covers the forward and reverse freight, subject to the guarantee terms.
